tests: Column headers rendered vertically, running bottom-to-top, at body text size.
attacks: Every geometry assumption at once. Rotated glyphs break the horizontal-line grouping that reading order, caption association and header detection all rely on; the header cells are tall and narrow, so a row-based grid reader may not align them with the columns beneath. Font weight is the only non-geometric signal available, and the rotated text is the same size as the body.
